games.title: Elden Ring
games.details: THE CRITICALLY ACCLAIMED FANTASY ACTION RPG. Rise, Tarnished, and be guided by grace to brandish the power of the Elden Ring and become an Elden Lord in the Lands Between

games.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.details: Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde Gang are outlaws on the run. With federal agents and bounty hunters massing on their heels, the gang must rob, steal, and fight their way across the rugged heartland in order to survive.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto V
games.details: Grand Theft Auto V offers players the option to explore the award-winning world of Los Santos and Blaine County in resolutions of up to 4k and beyond, as well as the chance to experience the game running at 60 frames per second.

games.title: The Witcher 3:Wild Hunt
games.details: You are Geralt of Rivia, mercenary monster slayer. Before you stands a war-torn, monster-infested continent you can explore at will. Your current contract? Tracking down Ciri — the Child of Prophecy, a living weapon that can alter the shape of the world.

games.title: EA Sports FC 25
games.details: EA SPORTS FC™ 25 gives you more ways to win for the club. Team up with friends in your favourite modes with the new 5v5 Rush, and manage your club to victory as FC IQ delivers more tactical control than ever before.

games.title: EA Sports FC 24
games.details: EA SPORTS FC™ 24 is a football simulation game developed by EA Vancouver and EA Romania, released on September 29, 2023. It features HyperMotionV, PlayStyles, and an enhanced Frostbite™ Engine, providing a true-to-football experience with over 19,000 fully licensed players and 700+ teams.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto IV
games.details: Niko Bellic, Johnny Klebitz and Luis Lopez all have one thing in common - they live in the worst city in America. Liberty City worships money and status, and is heaven for those who have them and a living nightmare for those who don't.

games.title: Need For Speed Most Wanted (2005)
games.details: In "Need for Speed: Most Wanted," players take on the role of a street racer who must compete against 15 elite racers known as the Blacklist.

games.title: Need For Speed PayBack
games.details: Set in the underworld of Fortune Valley, you and your crew were divided by betrayal and reunited by revenge to take down The House — a powerful cartel controlling the city’s casinos, criminals, and cops.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto San Andreas
games.details: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas is an action-adventure game played from a third-person view.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto Vice City
games.details: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City is a 2002 open-world action-adventure game developed by Rockstar North.

games.title: Roblex
games.details: Roblox is a free online gaming platform where players can play millions of games created by other users.

games.title: Call Of Duty
games.details: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II is a first-person shooter (FPS) that delivers a cinematic single-player campaign, fast-paced multiplayer combat, and cooperative Special Ops missions.
